# Aivoov

AiVOOV is an AI-driven text-to-speech platform that converts written text into natural-sounding voiceovers, offering over 1,000 voices across 150+ languages.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/aivoov/.

## Actions

- **List Voices** (read-only): Retrieve a list of available voices.
